thesis: CelcomDigi retains a credible operating repair resource, but the bear carries the cash-distribution objection at 19.31x trailing earnings. Statutory cash after capex and leases was RM445m versus RM821m dividends, while CFO fell and borrowings rose. Realized savings and positive post-lease cash preserve recovery potential, making neutral appropriate without treating the reported 5.42% yield as fully covered.
strongest_counterexample: RM141m realized savings and RM445m positive post-lease cash show that the network contributes funds after investment; further integration could close the payout gap without a business turnaround from losses.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable H1 with cash after capex/leases at least equal to dividends and borrowings no higher than RM14.461bn would defeat the current funding-restraint thesis.
Comparable H1 statutory CFO below RM1.222bn and post-lease cash at or below zero would undermine the retained repair counterweight.
decisive_factors: RM2.439bn presentation operating cash is a different definition and cannot replace RM1.222bn statutory CFO.
Normalized Q2 PAT growth of only 0.9% does not yet demonstrate cash repair; savings are not added again to cash.
